ytd.banner: Soldiers' Angels — YTD Through July: 2025 vs 2026
ytd.period: Jan 1 – May 31. Volunteer counts are distinct people.
ytd.disclaimer: During the January 1 – May 31, 2026 reporting period, a temporary ZIP code suspension limited our ability to process and record a portion of volunteer activity. We estimate that approximately 500 engagements were affected and are not fully reflected in the figures presented above. Accordingly, certain 2026 metrics — particularly engagement and support counts — may understate actual program activity for the period. This matter is being actively addressed, and we anticipate that subsequent reporting periods will capture the affected activity more completely. These figures should therefore be interpreted as a conservative representation of year-to-date performance.
